units.title: Foundation of Biochemistry

Concept of pH and pH scale, concept of acid and base balance with reference to Bronsted - Lowry concept, ionization of acids and bases. 2.3 Buffer - Definition, chemical nature of buff er, Derivation of 19 Henderson-Hassel Balch equation & its applications , buffering capacity, Types of buffer system in body fluid - Bicarbonate & phosphate system.

units.title: Amino acids and Proteins

Clinical significance - Maple syrup urine disease, AKU.

units.title: Enzymes
